name: Caribbean Ocean Trust grants
summary: Small grants of up to US$5,000 for projects by marine conservation NGOs working in the Caribbean, applied for with a downloadable form.

applicant_types.quote: Any marine conservation NGO operating in the Caribbean region may apply for grant funding for projects through the Caribbean Ocean Trust.

geography.quote: Any marine conservation NGO operating in the Caribbean region may apply for grant funding for projects through the Caribbean Ocean Trust.

access.quote: To apply for a grant, please download, complete and submit the appropriate form listed below.
